decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Mega Gengar. Clefable + Gengar lead uses Follow Me to shield Gengar on turn one, allowing Mega Gengar to trigger Shadow Tag and cripple physical threats like Excadrill and Kingambit with Will-O-Wisp or eliminate Whimsicott with Sludge Bomb. In the back, Empoleon punishes Gyarados's Intimidate via Competitive and handles the Sand duo with Shuca Berry protection, while Dragonite provides Multiscale longevity and ExtremeSpeed priority cleanup to secure the endgame.

Intended Mega: none — Blaziken stays home; opponent's Mega Gengar is the only Mega, so Kingambit (base) is my answer. Turn-one job: Hippowdon sets sand while Excadrill's Sand Rush (280 Spe) outspeeds their whole sheet and guaranteed-OHKOs Mega Gengar with HHP; Hippowdon Yawns or Protects. Back two: Gyarados gives Intimidate + 4x Ice Fang for Dragonite and a DD wincon; Kingambit walls Gengar, Iron-Heads Clefable, and closes with Sash/Sucker.

decisions.rationale: Excadrill in Sand outspeeds our entire team and threatens an immediate double KO with High Horsepower into Gengar and Iron Head into Clefable. Lum Berry on Dragonite also neutralizes potential Yawn pressure from Hippowdon.

reflections.adjustment: Abandon Gengar-Mega against Sand team-previews in favor of leading Dragonite with Clefable or Empoleon to suppress Sand Rush sweepers with water/ice pressure and ground redirection.

reflections.adjustment: Stop double-targeting a slot likely to Protect — turn 7 both attacks were wasted into Gengar's Protect while Dragonite attacked freely. On predicted Protect turns, split attacks across both slots or double the partner. Also expect them to focus-fire one slot (they doubled Hippowdon to secure the KO), so Protect or switch the obvious target; no preview change needed since their bring is static.
reflections.notebook: Tendencies (confirmed across both games): opponent brings the same four — Mega Gengar, Dragonite, Clefable, Empoleon — and Megas Gengar every time; does not adapt preview between games. Chained/predictable Protects, Follow Me shielding, WoW aimed at my lead physical attacker, never forfeits, stalls lost endgames, and will double-target one slot to force KOs. Strategic facts: Mega Gengar cannot damage Kingambit at all (Sludge Bomb immune, Shadow Ball resisted) — its only play is WoW, so Kingambit is a free counter they keep feeding. Dragonite prefers ESpeed/Claw into Kingambit over EQ, but respect EQ vs Kingambit/Excadrill. Excadrill's 140 Spe outspeeds their whole brought four with no sand — Hippowdon is expendable once Gengar dies. Empoleon without Shuca is OHKO'd by Excadrill HHP. Gyarados is the EQ-immune Intimidate pivot but gets neutralized by WoW. Plan if rematched: same bring works — Kingambit walls Gengar/Dragonite, Excadrill cleans; improvement is splitting attacks on predicted Protect turns and Protecting the obvious focus-fire target. Series won 2-0.
